{{Hatnote|For the promotional pack, see [[Rebel Leader Packs]]}}
'''Rebel Leader Pack (Scrye 4.2)''' is the June 1997 ''[[Scrye]]'' 4.2 magazine insert of a [[Rebel Leader Packs|Rebel Leader Pack]].<ref name="enc183">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=183 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 183–184 (Magazine Coverage). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="enc20mag">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf#page=50 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 2.0], pp. 50–52 (Magazine Promotions). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024031553/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The cover is Yoda art. The issue also packed Dagobah articles, a Dagobah rules supplement, and a Dagobah card checklist.<ref name="enc20mag" />
